tagline: Sign language recognition, collection to browser inference.
summary: An end-to-end sign language recognition project: collect images, build a dataset, train a classifier, and serve real-time predictions in the browser from webcam hand landmarks. It also exposes a headless REST endpoint and swaps trained models without a restart.
highlights: Real-time inference in the browser with no plugin: webcam to MediaPipe hand landmarks to a RandomForest prediction.
Hot model switching — a different .pkl is selected from the UI dropdown without restarting the server.
A headless REST endpoint accepts either a file upload or base64 JSON, so the model is usable outside the demo UI.
One-command setup: uv run app provisions Python, creates the virtual environment, installs dependencies and starts the server.
Reports F1 scores and the strongest and weakest classes from generated JSON model reports.
